ground_truth_matching: one-to-one greedy highest polygon IoU; primary IoU >= 0.30; recall also at IoU >= 0.50

HYBRID_A.agreement: polygon IoU >= 0.30 OR heuristic center inside RTMDet polygon and center distance <= 0.35 RTMDet crop diagonal
HYBRID_A.unpaired_heuristic: rejected from final hybrid; diagnostic only
HYBRID_A.unpaired_rtmdet: retained with RTMDet geometry, confidence=review, QC=detector_disagreement

HYBRID_B.unpaired_heuristic: rejected from final hybrid; diagnostic only
HYBRID_B.unpaired_rtmdet: retained with RTMDet geometry, confidence=review, QC=detector_disagreement

HYBRID_C.unpaired_heuristic: rejected from final hybrid; diagnostic only
HYBRID_C.unpaired_rtmdet: retained with RTMDet geometry, confidence=review, QC=detector_disagreement

pairing: one-to-one greedy candidate assignment, descending polygon IoU with deterministic index tie-break; each hybrid evaluated independently
